definitions.content:
name: github_release_day_expected
label: GitHub release day, expected
description: 'Metric 4 context. What release day would have been on GitHub''s trend and weekly rhythm:
  log(count) = a level per weekday + a linear trend, fitted on 1 Oct to 18 Nov 2026. Group by github_release_test__activity;
  the headline activity is prs_opened. Context, not the headline: report it beside github_release_day_change.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_release_test_expected

name: github_release_day_vs_expected
label: GitHub release day against expected
description: 'Metric 4 context. Release day against its prediction, in percent (-7.4 = 7.4% below). Group
  by github_release_test__activity; the headline activity is prs_opened. Context, not the headline: report
  it beside github_release_day_change.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_release_test_pct_vs_expected

name: github_release_day_t
label: GitHub release day, t statistic
description: 'Metric 4 context. One-sided t-test of release day against its prediction: the gap in prediction
  standard errors. The p-value is the Student t lower tail at github_release_day_df. Group by github_release_test__activity;
  the headline activity is prs_opened. Context, not the headline: report it beside github_release_day_change.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_release_test_t

name: github_release_day_df
label: GitHub release day, degrees of freedom
description: 'Metric 4 context. Degrees of freedom of the release-day t-test (fit days - 7 weekday levels
  - 1 trend). Group by github_release_test__activity; the headline activity is prs_opened. Context, not
  the headline: report it beside github_release_day_change.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_release_test_df
